name: arx_ping
description: Probe that answers pong. Confirms the harness is listening; no other use.

name: save
description: Put a claim candidate into this thread's quarantine and get back the claims already in force beside it. kind is fact or decision; why says what was rejected or what the code does not show. Nothing reaches the store before drain.

name: recall
description: Search a scope's claims in force for a query and return the matches. The result lands here as a tool result and changes nothing above it.

name: decisions_query
description: Search a scope's decisions in force for a query and return the matches with their ids. Use it for what is normal here before deciding anew.

name: decision
description: Fetch one claim by id from a scope, in full.

name: drain
description: Drain this thread's quarantine when the work is done. Without proposal: dispatch the drain hand over the quarantine; its proposal arrives as a [hand … drain proposal] line. With proposal set to that hand's id: apply it as one commit; overrides replaces the action for any candidate you read differently.

name: dispatch
description: Start a hand from a named agent definition with a self-contained brief and return its id at once; nothing blocks. The hand sees the brief and nothing else: not this window, not the store, not the state object. Its verdict, stop or exit arrives later as a [hand …] line with a trace handle. body, if given, must match the definition's.

name: tap
description: Read a hand's state, its brief, and the question it is stopped on, if any.

name: steer
description: Answer a stopped hand, or push a message into a running native hand. A claude-code or codex hand cannot take a message mid-turn; kill it and dispatch again.

name: kill
description: Tear the hand down. Its exit and trace handle arrive as a [hand …] line.

name: read_file
description: Read one UTF-8 text file under the workspace. path is relative to the workspace, or absolute inside it; offset is a 1-based line, limit a line count. A result over the admission threshold arrives as its head plus a handle with byte and line counts; read the handle with offset and limit for the part you need.

name: edit_file
description: Replace one exact occurrence of old with new in one existing file under the workspace. Fails when old is absent or matches more than once, and refuses arx's own state (store/, threads/, pid.txt). For a fix you can see whole; anything wider is a hand's brief.

name: list_files
description: List file and directory paths under the workspace. path is a directory relative to the workspace and defaults to the workspace root; depth is how many levels to descend, default 2, capped at 8. Directories end in a slash. Dotfiles, target/, node_modules/ and arx's own state (store/, threads/, pid.txt) are omitted, and a long listing arrives as a handle like any other oversized result. For seeing what is there; reading it is read_file, searching it is a hand.
